sources.entry: 500-mac-wallpaper - Simple macOS app for the status bar to automatically download photos from 500px.com to a local folder that can be set as a source of wallpapers.

summary.one_liner: A simple macOS status-bar app that downloads photos from 500px.com into a local folder that can be used as a wallpaper source.
summary.what_it_does: The README could not be retrieved, so this summary relies on the listing description from serhii-londar/open-source-mac-os-apps. That description says the app lives in the macOS status bar and automatically downloads photos from 500px.com to a local folder. The folder can then be set as a wallpaper source on macOS. Nothing beyond that is confirmed, and no details on settings, scheduling, or supported macOS versions were available.
use_cases: automatic macOS wallpaper rotation from photo site
status bar photo downloader for Mac
notable: Runs from the macOS status bar
Downloads photos from 500px.com into a local folder
Folder can be used as a macOS wallpaper source
caveats: README not available, so setup, build requirements, and license could not be verified
Depends on 500px.com as its photo source
